name: Kagamigawa Elise
source:
Mother of [url=/c13503]Chloe[/url] and a French woman. Elise is a calm and gentle woman. She had been separated with her husband Kouzou by circumstances, and now she appears in front of Chloe the first time in 12 years. She and Cloe have been in a relationship in which they could not contact each other, so when they finally meet, they both have many things to say to each other.
